notes: Calibrated with dev/RamProbeTool against Age of Empires: The Age of Kings (USA), DeSmuME and melonDS: `--calibrate=mode` over a scripted route (main menu, single player, campaign, mission, briefing, mission) found the candidates, `--watch` confirmed these two. The screen id is what makes this game typed: the AI can see which screen the game is on, and the walkthrough verifies its chapters from it. Values not listed here are screens nobody calibrated yet: add them after running the same route through the tool. The in-mission screen itself is not a landmark (a moving map, see docs/games.md), so memory is the only way to tell it.
